name: LMSYS-Chat-1M
description: LMSYS-Chat-1M is a large-scale dataset containing one million real-world conversations with 25 state-of-the-art LLMs, collected from diverse users, designed to study real-world LLM interactions and support various use cases including content moderation and safety benchmarking.
reputation: Widely used as a large real-world chat dataset for studying LLM behavior, safety, and preference modeling, and commonly referenced in LMSYS/Chatbot Arena-related work.
notes: Collected from 210K unique IPs; supports multiple use cases including training instruction-following models and building safety benchmarks.
